_readme: Media for the six stages on process.html. The stage copy lives in process.html, not here — this file only says what exists. Keys must match the data-stage attributes. A stage with no entry keeps its "pending" frame and costs no requests. width/height are the encoded display dimensions and shape the frame, so nothing is cropped: five stages were shot vertically and shaping landscape. webp and loop.webm are listed ONLY where those files exist — webm only where it actually came out smaller than the mp4, which on the daylight clips it did not. loop.mp4 is always present and is what Safari uses. See ASSETS.md for the encode.
